frame.definition: origin = mean of green ring incl. closing vertex; v = last centerline segment toward green; u = golfer's right

height_model.formula: z = (terrain(u,v) - z_ref) * vertical_exaggeration; terrain = bilinear in terrain.json (metres = z_dm/10)

how_to_use: pixel = M · [u, v, z, 1] (divide by the 3rd value). u,v = hole-frame metres (u right, v toward the green, origin green centre); z from height_model at (u,v). Ground points only (the ball is on the ground; tree crowns are not part of the height model).
trees: ILLUSTRATIVE woods where the locked 2023 NAIP canopy grid shows canopy; crown shapes, 8 m nominal height and colours are style, not surveyed trees
terrain: 2021 USGS 3DEP lidar bare earth (2 m), vertical exaggeration 1.50x; bunker depths and tee/green edge bevels are cosmetic
